additionalInformation: Those with A-level or H2 pass in Chemistry are not allowed to read this course.
description: The objective of this course is to provide an introduction to the fundamental topics and concepts of chemistry. this includes topics like structure of matter, periodicity and the periodic table, chemical bonding, states of matter, stoichiometry and equilibrium, reaction types, thermodynamics, kinetics, organic chemistry, including such topics as functional groups and isomerism.
